Chain snatchers arrested in separate incidents, stolen gold recovered

Two separate incidents of chain snatching have led to the arrest of suspects in Delhi and Mangaluru. In both cases, stolen gold ornaments were recovered by the police. These arrests highlight ongoing efforts to address property crime in urban areas.
